verdict.rationale: Rollbar's own source-maps docs say minified JavaScript needs source maps supplied to Rollbar, and that stack traces then show the original filename, line number, method name and code coordinates. That covers the de-minification outcome. The evidence never says how maps are uploaded, so the CI, CLI and bundler-plugin parts of the story are unproven. Missing for 10: a documented CLI or bundler plugin (e.g. webpack/Vite) for uploading source maps, CI pipeline upload instructions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can upload JavaScript source maps from CI — via CLI or bundler plugin — so production stack traces show my original source, not minified frames

citations.quote: If you minify your JavaScript code, you need to provide Rollbar with access to your source maps to understand your items' stack traces
Stack traces will contain the original source filename, line number, method name, and code coordinates
